resolves_the_doubt: Confirms the doubt: the strains are clinical isolates selected from a reference collection, "identified between years 2003 and 2013", without identification method or country or hospital of origin.
evidence: "The selected strains were clinical isolates identified between years 2003 and 2013 and deposited in the culture collection of Fungus Testing Laboratory ... San Antonio" (p. 737) || Table 1 (p. 738): "C. tropicalis (n:37)" FLU S 28/SDD 2/R 7; VOR 28/4/5; POS S 33/R 4 || "The MICs were confirmed by broth microdilution following the CLSI M27-A3 guidelines" (p. 737)
note: Even if identification and country were accepted, the strains were chosen to have susceptible and resistant ones (validation of MALDI-TOF): the proportion of resistance is conditioned by selection and does not estimate prevalence. Do not use in the MA.

title: Molecular And Phenotypic Characterization Of Candida Species: Virulence Factors, Antifungal Susceptibility And Resistance Genes In Clinical Isolates
original_doubt: AST reported only for C. albicans (n=53) and non-albicans aggregated (n=85), not disaggregated for C. tropicalis. Detection by conventional PCR of the presence of the genes ERG11, MDR1, CDR1, CDR2 (not mutations or expression), supposedly in fluconazole-resistant isolates; biological interpretation doubtful. Internal inconsistencies (biofilm percentages, 'micafungin less effective' 94% R).
source: Various clinical samples (urine, sputum, blood, vaginal exudate, pus, endotracheal secretion), without breakdown by species
country: Not identifiable by the sampling (affiliation only: Lucknow, India)
identification_method: Germ tube, morphology on cornmeal agar, sugar assimilation and MALDI-TOF MS
susceptibility_method: Disk diffusion (Kirby-Bauer) on Mueller-Hinton with 2% glucose and methylene blue
interpretive_criterion: "CLSI guidelines" without document or version
molecular_or_genotype: Conventional PCR for "presence" of ERG11 (10.3%), MDR1 (3.4%), CDR1 (3.4%) and CDR2 (1.7%) in 58 C. tropicalis; without mutation or expression
resolves_the_doubt: Confirms the doubt: the sampling only says "conducted in the department of Microbiology", without hospital, city or country; India comes solely from the affiliations. Susceptibility is given for C. albicans versus non-albicans aggregated.
evidence: "A prospective observational study was conducted in the department of Microbiology. Candida species collected from patients received the department of Microbiology were processed." (p. 183) || "the ERG11 gene was identified in 10.3% of 58 Candida tropicalis isolates" (p. 188) || "Antifungal susceptibility testing was performed using CLSI guidelines" (p. 184)
note: Even if India were accepted, it is not suitable for the MA (susceptibility not disaggregated and CLSI no version). The "presence" of ERG11 by PCR is not a resistance determinant (it is a constitutive gene): the molecular data are hardly interpretable.
